next:fc:199.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:199.hint: 付帯状況を表すwith+名詞+分詞
next:fc:199.question: 「彼は腕を組んでソファに横たわっていた」を表すのは?
next:fc:199.fullSentence: He lay on the sofa with his arms folded.
next:fc:199.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞『〜が…された状態で』。
next:fc:199.relatedInfo: 腕は「組まれる」ものなので過去分詞foldedを使う。

next:fc:200.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:200.hint: あなたがそこに立っていては歌を歌えない
next:fc:200.question: I can't sing a song with you _____ there.
next:fc:200.fullSentence: I can't sing a song with you standing there.
next:fc:200.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+現在分詞『〜が…している状態で』。
next:fc:200.relatedInfo: standは能動的な動作なので現在分詞standingを使う。

next:fc:201.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:201.hint: 完了形の受動分詞構文(beingの省略)
next:fc:201.question: 「やさしい英語で書かれているので、この本は読みやすい」を表すのは?
next:fc:201.fullSentence: Having written in easy English, this book is easy to read.
next:fc:201.explanation: 完了形の受動分詞構文(Having been written→beingは省略可)。
next:fc:201.relatedInfo: Having been written と同じ意味。

next:fc:202.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:202.hint: 宿題を終えたので、私は寝た
next:fc:202.question: _____ my homework, I went to bed.
next:fc:202.fullSentence: Having finished my homework, I went to bed.
next:fc:202.explanation: 完了分詞構文(Having+Vpp)。主節の時制より前の出来事を表す。
next:fc:202.relatedInfo: Finishing my homeworkだと主節と同時になってしまう。

next:fc:203.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:203.hint: There is構文の独立分詞構文
next:fc:203.question: 「バスがなかったので、歩かなければならなかった」を表すのは?
next:fc:203.fullSentence: There being no bus, I had to walk.
next:fc:203.explanation: There is構文の独立分詞構文。
next:fc:203.relatedInfo: Because there was no bus, ~ と書き換え可能。

next:fc:204.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:204.hint: 会社はその結果を公表することにした
next:fc:204.question: The company decided to make the results _____.
next:fc:204.fullSentence: The company decided to make the results known.
next:fc:204.explanation: make O known『Oを知らせる、公表する』。make+O+過去分詞(既知の状態にする)の語法。
next:fc:204.relatedInfo: make oneself understoodと同じmake+O+過去分詞のパターン。

next:fc:205.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:205.hint: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞
next:fc:205.question: 「腕を組んで」座っている様子を表すには?
next:fc:205.fullSentence: He was sitting with his arms folded.
next:fc:205.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞の練習例文。
next:fc:205.relatedInfo: 腕は「組まれる」受動関係なのでfoldedを使う。

next:fc:206.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:206.question: He was sitting with his legs _____.
next:fc:206.fullSentence: He was sitting with his legs crossed.
next:fc:206.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞。
next:fc:206.relatedInfo: 脚は「組まれる」受動関係なのでcrossedを使う。

next:fc:207.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:207.hint: 体の一部の位置を示す付帯状況表現
next:fc:207.question: 「頬杖をついて」を表すのは?
next:fc:207.answer: with his chin on his hands
choices: with his chin on his hands
with his chin at his hands
with his chin in his hands
next:fc:207.fullSentence: He was sitting with his chin on his hands.
next:fc:207.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:fc:207.relatedInfo: 分詞ではなく前置詞句が続く付帯状況の形もある。

next:fc:208.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:208.question: He was sitting with a pipe _____ his mouth.
next:fc:208.fullSentence: He was sitting with a pipe in his mouth.
next:fc:208.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。

next:fc:209.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:209.hint: 体の状態を表す付帯状況の過去分詞
next:fc:209.question: 「目を閉じて」を表すのは?
next:fc:209.fullSentence: He was sitting with his eyes closed.
next:fc:209.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞。
next:fc:209.relatedInfo: 目は「閉じられる」受動関係なのでclosedを使う。

next:fc:210.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:210.question: You should decide with this _____ mind.
next:fc:210.fullSentence: You should decide with this in mind.
next:fc:210.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。決断する際の慣用表現。
next:fc:210.relatedInfo: with A in mindで『Aを念頭に置いて』。

next:fc:211.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:211.hint: 体の位置関係を表す付帯状況表現
next:fc:211.question: 「壁にもたれて」立っている様子を表すには?
next:fc:211.answer: with his back against the wall
choices: with his back against the wall
with his back on the wall
with his back to against the wall
with against the wall his back
next:fc:211.fullSentence: He was standing with his back against the wall.
next:fc:211.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:fc:211.relatedInfo: against the wallで『壁に押し当てて』。

next:fc:212.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:212.question: He was standing with a book _____ his arm.
next:fc:212.fullSentence: He was standing with a book under his arm.
next:fc:212.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:fc:212.relatedInfo: under one's armで『脇にかかえて』。

next:fc:213.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:213.hint: 体の状態を表す付帯状況の形容詞
next:fc:213.question: 「物を食べながら(口をいっぱいにしながら)」話す様子を表すには?
next:fc:213.fullSentence: He was talking with his mouth full.
next:fc:213.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+形容詞。
next:fc:213.relatedInfo: 分詞だけでなく形容詞も付帯状況のwith構文に使える。

next:fc:214.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:fc:214.question: He was sitting with snow _____ his hair.
next:fc:214.fullSentence: He was sitting with snow in his hair.
next:fc:214.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。

next:fc:215.hint: 2つのものが同程度であることを表す原級比較
next:fc:215.question: 「このかばんはあのかばんと同じくらい重い」を表すのは?
next:fc:215.fullSentence: This bag is as heavy as that one.
next:fc:215.relatedInfo: notを伴うとA<Bの意味になる。

next:fc:216.hint: この本はあの本ほど面白くない
next:fc:216.question: This book is not _____ interesting as that one.
next:fc:216.fullSentence: This book is not as interesting as that one.
next:fc:216.relatedInfo: notを伴わない原級比較(A=B)との対比。

next:fc:217.hint: 数えられない名詞を使った原級比較の否定形
next:fc:217.question: 「彼は兄ほどお金を持っていない」を表すのは?(数えられない名詞)
next:fc:217.fullSentence: He doesn't have as much money as his brother.
next:fc:217.explanation: not as much+原級+as(数えられない名詞のA<B比較)。
next:fc:217.relatedInfo: 数えられる名詞ならas many ... asを使う。

next:fc:218.hint: できるだけ早く返信してください
next:fc:218.question: Please reply as soon as _____.
next:fc:218.fullSentence: Please reply as soon as possible.
next:fc:218.explanation: as+原級+as possible ＝ as+原級+as S can『できるだけ〜』。
next:fc:218.relatedInfo: as soon as you canとも言い換え可能。

next:fc:219.hint: 倍数表現を使った比較
next:fc:219.question: 「これはあれの3倍高い」を表すのは?
next:fc:219.fullSentence: This is three times as expensive as that one.
next:fc:219.explanation: X times as+原級+as B(倍数表現、A>B)。
next:fc:219.relatedInfo: twice, half も同じ枠組みで使う。

next:fc:220.hint: この箱はあの箱の2倍重い
next:fc:220.question: This box is _____ as heavy as that one.
next:fc:220.fullSentence: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
next:fc:220.relatedInfo: 三倍以上はX timesを使う。

next:fc:221.hint: 半分の程度を表す原級比較
next:fc:221.question: 「これはあれの半額だ」を表すのは?
next:fc:221.fullSentence: This is half as expensive as that one.
next:fc:221.explanation: half as+原級+as B『Bの半分ほど〜』。
next:fc:221.relatedInfo: twice as ... asの反対の関係。

next:fc:222.hint: 彼女は私の2倍の数の本を持っている
next:fc:222.question: She has twice the _____ of books that I have.
next:fc:222.fullSentence: She has twice the number of books that I have.
next:fc:222.explanation: twice the+名詞+of/that B(名詞を使った倍数表現)。
next:fc:222.relatedInfo: twice as many books as I have とも言い換え可能。

next:fc:223.hint: AというよりむしろBを表す比較表現
next:fc:223.question: 「彼は学者というよりむしろ作家だ」を表すのは?
next:fc:223.answer: not so much a scholar as
choices: not so much a scholar as
not so much as a scholar
not as much a scholar as
not so a scholar much as
next:fc:223.fullSentence: He is not so much a scholar as a writer.
next:fc:223.explanation: not so much A as B『AというよりむしろB』。＝B rather than A。
next:fc:223.relatedInfo: A、Bの位置に注意(否定されるのがA)。
